name: bv-bahia-archers-league
description: Sistema de organización y gestión de torneos de la Liga Bahiense de Arquería

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:libs && concurrently -n shared,ui,cliente,api,app,landing -c gray,cyan,yellow,blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @bal/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/ui dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/cliente dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/api dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/app dev" "pnpm --filter @bal/landing dev"
scripts.build:libs: pnpm --filter @bal/shared build && pnpm --filter @bal/ui build && pnpm --filter @bal/cliente build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @bal/api build && pnpm --filter @bal/app build && pnpm --filter @bal/landing build && node scripts/precomprimir.mjs
